async function run(){if(Date.now()<nextAttempt||busy||blocked||!getUser()||isDemo()||!navigator.onLine)return;const ctx=context();busy=true;try{await recover(ctx);if(blocked||ctx.generation!==generation)return;const local=clone(snapshot());await checkpoint(ctx.key,local);const remote=await request('GET');if(ctx.generation!==generation||ctx.key!==getKey()||!getUser()||isDemo())return;let current=clone(snapshot()),desired=current;if(remote.state){const merged=mergeStates(baseline||undefined,current,remote.state);if(merged.conflicts.length){blocked=true;status('Conflicting edits retained locally. Export, then restore cloud or review: '+merged.conflicts.slice(0,3).join(', '),'conflict');return;}desired=merged.state;}if(!same(current,desired)){apply(desired);current=clone(snapshot());}revision=remote.revision;baseline=remote.state||null;if(!same(current,remote.state)){await checkpoint(ctx.key,current);const result=await request('PUT',{revision,state:current});if(ctx.generation!==generation||ctx.key!==getKey()||!getUser()||isDemo())return;revision=result.revision;baseline=current;}else baseline=current;localStorage.setItem(ctx.key+'-revision',String(revision));localStorage.setItem(ctx.key+'-sync-base',JSON.stringify(baseline));const latest=clone(snapshot());await checkpoint(ctx.key,latest);if(same(latest,baseline)){localStorage.removeItem(ctx.key+'-dirty');status('Synced · '+new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], {hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'}),'synced');}else{localStorage.setItem(ctx.key+'-dirty','1');status('New changes pending','pending');schedule();}failures=0;nextAttempt=0;}catch(e){failures++;nextAttempt=Date.now()+Math.min(300000,15000*2**Math.min(failures-1,5));status((e.sourceMessage||e.message).includes('newer')?'Another device changed the kitchen. Retrying with its latest version.':'Saved on this device · sync pending: '+e.message,'pending');}finally{busy=false;}}

function schedule(){context();clearTimeout(timer);if(getUser()&&!isDemo()){status(navigator.onLine?'Saving automatically…':'Offline · changes queued on this device','pending');const ctx=context();void recover(ctx).then(()=>{if(!blocked&&ctx.generation===generation)return checkpoint(ctx.key,clone(snapshot()));}).catch(()=>status('Local backup retained; durable queue unavailable','pending'));timer=setTimeout(run,1000);}}
